sampling_contract.analysis_weight: stage_windows, applied once per sampled joint window

reference_model.time_interval: half-open [start,end); a resource is reusable at end

common_hardware_boundary.relation_workspace: one existing Local5 transpose/frontier workspace, included in every candidate
common_hardware_boundary.term_builder: one identical source-major FIFO2 term builder
common_hardware_boundary.execution_lane: one identical Direct legal single-port 1RW five-bank lane
common_hardware_boundary.final_boundary: one common 450x1024-bit vector drain and serializer
common_hardware_boundary.numeric_contract: real invalid mask, hardware-order per-output-tile input-head accumulation, Acc32 modulo 2^32

c0_direct_serial.acc_lifecycle: prepare, heads 0..H-1 accumulate in order, drain, free

c1_reuse_only_s2.acc_lifecycle: prepare both contexts, heads 0..H-1 accumulate in order, serial common drain, free

c2_overlap_only.acc_lifecycle: prepare, heads 0..H-1 accumulate in order, drain, free
c2_overlap_only.epoch_lifecycle: slot i refill starts only after task i-2 consumer retirement

c3_erep_s2.acc_lifecycle: prepare both contexts, heads 0..H-1 accumulate in order, serial common drain, free
c3_erep_s2.epoch_lifecycle: slot i refill starts only after task i-2 consumer retirement

c4_capacity_matched_relation_memo.admission_model: offline optimal 0/1 knapsack upper bound reported separately from any implementable policy
c4_capacity_matched_relation_memo.purpose: upper-bound a cache-only use of the same incremental data-state budget

c5_full_relation_memo.purpose: larger-area exact-reuse upper bound, not an area-fair baseline

strong_architecture_baselines.stripe_selection_rule: C3-S2 remains the frozen primary point; sensitivity results cannot replace it without a new hold-out cohort

schedule_and_lifecycle.output_stripe_order: increasing pairs with an explicit one-tile remainder
schedule_and_lifecycle.epoch_visibility: only after all active records are written and atomic seal completes
schedule_and_lifecycle.epoch_fill_contents: relation build plus source-major compaction plus one 112-bit 1RW write per active record plus seal
schedule_and_lifecycle.epoch_consume_contents: one 112-bit 1RW read per active record through FIFO2 and the unchanged Direct backend
schedule_and_lifecycle.drain_order: contexts in increasing output-tile order through one common vector port
schedule_and_lifecycle.context_reuse: only after drain retirement; next use starts with a new lazy generation
schedule_and_lifecycle.same_cycle_reuse: allowed only at the prior half-open interval end, never before

identity_keyed_service.canonical_identity_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators
identity_keyed_service.fairness_check: the identity-to-delay map of all common logical transactions must be byte-identical across candidates

rtl_phase_trace_inputs.direct_cycles_by_tile: instrumented existing Direct serial RTL for each window/head/output-tile logical identity
rtl_phase_trace_inputs.epoch_fill_cycles: instrumented relation workspace through active-record slot writes and atomic seal
rtl_phase_trace_inputs.execute_cycles_by_tile: instrumented sealed slot through FIFO2, Direct 1RW backend and per-head flush
rtl_phase_trace_inputs.drain_cycles_by_tile: instrumented common 450x1024-bit vector drain under identity-keyed service
rtl_phase_trace_inputs.direct_reconstruction_check: phase ledger must reconstruct each measured direct task/window boundary exactly

statistics_contract.primary_estimand: sum_j(w_j*C0_j) / sum_j(w_j*Cx_j) over 1200 sampled joint windows
statistics_contract.forbidden_estimand: weighted mean of per-window speedup ratios

bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric sequence-cluster bootstrap with replacement; retain all samples in each selected cluster

statistics_contract.weighted_p95: inverse-inclusion-weight empirical CDF within each stage
statistics_contract.stage_p95_non_regression: upper bound of paired bootstrap delta p95=(C3-C0) must be <=0
statistics_contract.stage_p95_familywise_control: four one-sided tests, Bonferroni alpha=0.0125, individual 98.75 percent upper bounds

g0_profile_and_model.permission_on_fail: stop Local5 architecture RTL expansion and return to Motion evidence

g2_physical.fairness: same process, voltage, SDC, SRAM macro rules, activity workload and floorplan policy

evidence_boundary: v2 freezes a candidate and evaluation protocol. It contains no formal joint-head result, no EREP RTL result, and no ASIC PPA.
